info.name: ElevenPOS Ecommerce API v1
info.description:
Complete API collection for the ElevenPOS ecommerce platform.

## Setup
1. Import `postman-environment.json` and select it as the active environment.
2. Set `base_url` to your store domain (e.g., `https://your-store.com`).
3. Set `public_key` to your `pk_...` API key.
4. Set `secret_key` to your `sk_...` API key.
5. Run **Customer Register** or **Customer Login** — the `customer_token` will auto-populate.
6. Run **Add Item to Cart** — `cart_token` and `cart_item_id` will auto-populate.
7. Run **Place Order** — `order_id` will auto-populate.

## Auth Quick Reference
| Endpoint Type | X-Api-Key | Authorization |
|---|---|---|
| Catalog (read) | `{{public_key}}` | None |
| Write (reviews, contact, orders) | `{{secret_key}}` | None |
| Customer profile, orders, wishlist | `{{public_key}}` | `Bearer {{customer_token}}` |
| Cart (guest) | `{{public_key}}` | None (use X-Cart-Token) |

## Documentation
See `API.md` in the same folder for full endpoint documentation with use cases and examples.

Returns all active brands. Use to populate brand filter on product listing pages.

query.description: Search by product name or SKU

request.description:
Paginated product list with optional filters.

**Tip:** `barcodes[0].after_discount` is the display price. If equal to `selling_price`, no discount is active.

**Important:** For complex products (multiple variants), always fetch full product detail for all barcodes/attributes.

**Important:** Use `barcodes[].id` as `barcode_id` when adding to cart or placing an order.
Products marked as featured. Use for homepage 'Featured Products' section.
Active flash sales with `ends_at` timestamp. Use `ends_at` to drive a countdown timer on the homepage.

item.name: 05. Product Engagement
item.description: Reviews, comments, and Q&A for products.

request.description: Approved reviews for a product. Use in the reviews tab on product detail page.

Submit a product review. Goes into pending approval queue — admin must approve before it shows publicly.

**Fields:** customer_name (required), customer_email (optional), rating (1-5, required), review (optional)
Approved comments for a product.
Submit a comment. Requires admin approval.
Publicly visible answered Q&A for a product.
Ask a question about a product.
All approved reviews across all products. Use for a testimonials page showing store-wide social proof.

item.name: 06. Customer Authentication
item.description: Customer registration, login, logout, and profile management.

request.description:
Create a new customer account.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `customer_token` environment variable on success.

**Errors:** 422 if email already registered or passwords don't match.

Authenticate a customer and get a Bearer token.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `customer_token` environment variable.

**Errors:** 422 if credentials invalid, 403 if account inactive.
Invalidates the current access token. Clear stored token in your app after this call.
Returns the authenticated customer's profile. Use to pre-fill checkout address fields.
Update customer profile. All fields are optional. Include `password` and `password_confirmation` to change password.

item.name: 07. Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart management for guests and authenticated customers.

**Guest:** Include `X-Cart-Token: {{cart_token}}` header. On first add, the token is returned in the response and auto-set by the test script.

**Authenticated:** Include `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}` instead of X-Cart-Token.

header.description: Use this for guest cart. Remove if using Authorization header.
Use this for authenticated cart. Remove if using X-Cart-Token.

request.description: Returns current cart with items, quantities, and subtotal.

header.description: Include for guest cart (empty on first call — token returned in response)

request.description:
Add a product variant to the cart. Use `barcode_id` from `GET /products/{slug}` → `barcodes[].id`.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `cart_token` and `cart_item_id` environment variables.

**Errors:** 422 if product not found, out of stock, or quantity exceeds max order quantity.
Update quantity of a cart item. Use `cart_item_id` from cart response (`data.items[].id`).
Remove a single item from the cart.
Removes all items from the cart. Returns an empty cart object.

item.name: 08. Orders
item.description: Order placement and retrieval. Requires secret key (sk_...).

request.description:
Place a new order. Creates or finds customer contact by phone number.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `order_id` environment variable.

**Important:** Validate coupon via `POST /coupons/validate` before this call to show live discount preview.

**Errors:** 422 if out of stock, invalid coupon, or validation failure.

query.description: Must match the customer phone on the order (required)

request.description:
Retrieve order details without customer login — verified by phone number match.

**Use case:** Order tracking page accessible without an account.

item.name: 09. Customer Orders (Protected)
item.description: Order history and details for authenticated customers. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}.

request.description:
Paginated list of the authenticated customer's orders.

**Order statuses:** draft, pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned
**Payment statuses:** due, partial, paid
Full order detail including line items, shipping info, tracking number, and payment history.

item.name: 10. Payments
item.description: Payment initiation and verification. Requires secret key.

request.description:
Initiate payment for an order via a payment gateway.

**gateway values:** `sslcommerz`, `stripe`

**SSLCommerz:** Returns `gateway_url` — redirect customer to this URL.
**Stripe:** Returns `client_secret` — use with Stripe.js to confirm payment.

**Errors:** 422 if order already paid or no outstanding balance.

Verify SSLCommerz payment after customer returns from payment page.

**val_id:** From SSLCommerz callback query params.
**value_a:** The order ID passed during payment initiation.

Show success/failure UI based on `success` boolean in response.
Verify Stripe payment after successful payment intent confirmation via Stripe.js.

SSLCommerz IPN (Instant Payment Notification) webhook.

**Do NOT call this from frontend.** SSLCommerz calls this automatically on payment events.

No API key required — called by SSLCommerz servers directly.

Validate a coupon code and preview the discount amount.

**Returns:** discount_type (fixed/percentage), discount_value, discount_amount, final_total.

**Tip:** Call on coupon field submit/blur — not on every keystroke.

**Errors:** 422 if invalid, expired, or usage limit exceeded.

item.name: 12. Returns & Refunds (Protected)
item.description: Order return requests. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}.

request.description:
All return requests for the authenticated customer.

**Return statuses:** pending, approved, rejected, cancelled

Submit a return request. Order must be in 'shipped' or 'delivered' status.

Get `sale_detail_id` from `GET /customer/orders/{id}` → `items[].id`.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `return_id` environment variable.

**Errors:** 422 if order not in returnable status or duplicate pending return exists.
Details of a specific return request including line items and status.

Cancel a pending return request. Only works on 'pending' status returns.

**Errors:** 422 if not in pending status.

item.name: 13. Wishlist (Protected)
item.description: Customer wishlist management. Requires Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}.

request.description: Returns all wishlisted products for the authenticated customer.

Add a product to wishlist by slug.

**Test script:** Auto-sets `wishlist_item_id`.

**Response:** 201 if newly added, 200 if already in wishlist — check status code to update heart icon state.
Remove an item from the wishlist using the wishlist item ID (not product ID).

Returns loyalty point balance, point value, minimum redemption threshold, and transaction history.

**Errors:** 404 if loyalty system is disabled for the store.

**Tip:** Show `points_earned` from the order creation response on the order confirmation page.
